criteria.requirement: Implement dpath.exact.get_exact(root,segments,default=marker). Paths are finite component iterables, never plain strings; mapping keys retain actual hashable types and punctuation, list indices are nonnegative int excluding bool. Empty path returns root identity. Missing key/index returns an explicit default or raises original error, while invalid traversal/type errors propagate. Do not interpret glob characters, coerce "1" to integer, trigger defaultdict creation, or mutate input; preserve old dpath.get.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
